shortDescription: Polymarket’s "Clemson vs. California" event saw a sharp move in the submarket "2Q O/U 19.5," where the "Over" option rose from 30% one hour earlier to 49.5% at present, a 19.5 percentage-point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the sudden volatility may reflect the impact of breaking news.
